name: chrome-budget
description: Keeps chrome-devtools-mcp from flooding the model context: a capped default browser, an uncapped one for pixel work, and a guard that redirects expensive calls to cheap equivalents.

screenshot_max_width.title: Screenshot max width (px)
screenshot_max_width.description: Screenshots wider than this are downscaled before they reach the model. Image cost scales with area, not file size, so this is the only setting that actually reduces screenshot tokens.

screenshot_max_height.title: Screenshot max height (px)
screenshot_max_height.description: Same as the width cap, applied to height. The smaller of the two scale factors wins.

enforcement.title: Enforcement level
enforcement.description: 'correct' rewrites expensive calls into their cheap equivalent and explains what changed. 'warn' explains without rewriting. 'off' disables the guard. Nothing is ever refused. ('block' is accepted as a synonym for 'correct'.)
